ops-bot: PAGER: P1 gen-queue error spike in eu-west-1 — elevated 5xxs on /v1/generate. Error rate ~15% over last 3m. Oncall: @Priya K. https://pager.link/incident/7012345678
Priya K: I'm on it, joining the call.
Priya K: Drafting initial statuspage copy — ping review please:
Priya K: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting text generation in EU (eu-west-1). Some requests may fail or time out. Engineers are actively investigating and implementing mitigation steps. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
Alex L: Two quick asks: 1) call out which endpoints/regions (you did) and 2) avoid implying full mitigation. Maybe say "implementing mitigation steps" not "mitigation complete". Also can we add an estimated percent impacted?
Priya K: OK — updated draft with estimate: "Approximately 10–15% of requests may be impacted."
Marta (Legal): Please avoid % if not confirmed by telemetry team. Also replace "implementing mitigation steps" with "implementing temporary routing changes to mitigate impact" to be precise.
Priya K: New draft per legal: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting text generation in EU (eu-west-1). Some customers may experience failures when calling text generation endpoints. Engineers are implementing temporary routing changes to mitigate the issue. Updates expected every 15 minutes."
Sam O: Looks good. I'll take customer outbound once we confirm stabilization. Recommend publishing the initial notice now and add impacted-customer list to the incident page.
Priya K: Publishing initial notice now. Cmd: ```/statuspage publish "Initial: Investigating elevated 5xx errors in EU (eu-west-1)."``` :rotating_light:
ops-bot: statuspage: initial incident posted — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/7012345678
Priya K: On the mitigation plan: routing traffic off a subset of genqueue hosts, failover to small-model pool, and rolling restart of affected nodes. Logs show KV cache errors on a small percentage of hosts.
Alex L: Good. If routing reduces error rate, prepare resolved draft that calls out mitigation (temporary routing + restart) and notes we are doing a post-incident analysis. Avoid RCA in public copy.
Marta (Legal): Agreed — do not attribute root cause publicly.
Priya K: Resolved draft (for review): "Resolved: The elevated error rate has subsided after routing traffic away from affected hosts and restarting impacted services. Service is operational. We are conducting a post-incident analysis and will publish a follow-up when available. If you continue to see issues, contact support@redwood.ai." Any objections?
Sam O: LGTM. Add resolution timestamp and contact link (done). I'll queue the customer email summarizing impact + mitigation after you publish.
Priya K: Published resolved at 2026-03-17T18:05:00Z. Closing main pager and handing monitoring to @Oncall Rotation for 30m.
Oncall Rotation: Acknowledged. Monitoring for 30m; will escalate to Eng-SRE on regression.
ops-bot: Pager closed (7012345678).
